notes: R[j, i, P_idx, T_idx] = mean over prompts of language P, then over CoT tokens, of p_target / (p_en + p_target). Probabilities come from full-vocab logit-lens summed by language (punct / special / other dropped). Cells where p_en + p_target = 0 are NaN and excluded from the means. English is excluded from the target list because R(en) = 0.5 by construction.
